cards.deed: Brought a pet into the Crawl
cards.notes: Story Box card (spec §2.8): GM-triggered only, hand-pick, never drawn. trigger_deed: first Crawler at the table to bring a pet into the Crawl, judged by the GM (canon trigger not captured in the ledger). Banner adds the tier: Legendary Pet Box. Item canon I-007 and M-037; mechanics are HOUSE. power_note: Story keystone (pattern C), consumed once, rung 0 numbers: the new Crawler is a CR 1/4 Beast stat block plus a class at party level, so it adds a Crawler to encounter budgets and uses the owner's one consumable for the floor. Once fed it's consumed; the pet-Crawler can't be traded; one conversion per living pet-Crawler (a deleted pet-Crawler frees its conversion; a new conversion still needs a new Enhanced Pet Biscuit, which uses a Story Box slot). An unused biscuit is a normal tradable, sellable, lootable item. The pet-Crawler is a separate player-controlled Crawler played by the owner, takes no extra slot. Hook: the pet now has opinions, and the audience adores it. (rules/45 section 4.5) Not bound (bound is false): lootable, tradeable, sellable like any item; story_value is provenance only and never the buyback base; sale_value 100 (System buyback at Floor-1 scale, times the multiplier of the sale floor at runtime). Opens only in a saferoom: the deed is recorded and announced at award and the box waits unopened until the next saferoom. Death before a saferoom (Caleb's 2026-10-04 ruling): an unopened Story Box is reclaimed if the Crawler dies before a saferoom, and the slot is freed (the one-per-floor cap no longer counts it; the GM may award a Story Box again). This replaces the older rule where the box stayed closed and the cap stayed used.
